summary: Preserve the JSON.parse reviver context.source text for primitive parse results.

target.notes: The parse helper must retain source slices/parse records when the reviver can observe its third context argument. For unmodified primitive values context.source is the exact JSON source text for that value.

semantics.context: Each reviver call receives a fresh context object; primitive parse values expose source when the specification defines it.
semantics.precision_use_case: context.source can retain digits that were lost when the JSON number was converted to Number.
semantics.objects: Object/array reviver contexts do not fabricate a primitive source string.

caveats: This is newer JSON.parse semantics and cannot be dropped merely because the parsed Number already lost precision.

tests.name: source preserves original large integer digits
tests.input: let src; JSON.parse('9007199254740993',(k,v,c)=>{if(k==='') src=c.source; return v;}); console.log(src);
tests.expected_behavior: prints 9007199254740993 even though the Number value is rounded

tests.name: escaped string source is source text not cooked value
tests.input: let src; JSON.parse('"\u0061"',(k,v,c)=>{if(k==='') src=c.source; return v;}); console.log(src);
tests.expected_behavior: prints the JSON source token including quotes and escape spelling
